title: 🔥 PRAYER ISN’T PASSIVE — IT’S WARFARE 🔥
paragraphs:
When you drop to your knees, hell trembles.
When you speak His name, darkness loses ground.
Prayer isn’t silence—it’s strategy. It’s not weakness—it’s warfare. ⚔️

God doesn’t need you to be loud.
He just needs you to be faithful. 🙏
Every whispered prayer shakes the unseen.

“For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds.”
— 2 Corinthians 10:4 ✝️
🎬 This isn’t just a poster—it’s a declaration.
